descriptionChirho: Locative deictic adverb פֹּה indicating the speaker's current location or a proximal place: 'here, in this place' (Gen 19:12, Ex 3:5, 1 Sam 21:10). Translations uniformly render a static locative meaning: eng: here, spa: aquí, hin: यहाँ, arb: هُنَا, kor: 여기에, swa: hapa. The waw-prefixed form וּפֹה is a discourse connector, not a distinct sense.

Ablative-directional use of פֹּה with preposition מִן, yielding מִפֹּה 'from here, from this side,' indicating a point of departure or one of two opposing sides (Gen 37:17, Ex 11:1, Num 22:18, 1 Kgs 22:17). Multilingual evidence confirms a distinct directional/ablative meaning absent from the bare form: eng: from-here, spa: de-aquí, hin: से–इस–ओर, arb: مِنْ–هُنَا, kor: 이쪽–에서, swa: upande-huu.
